Initial release of smyx-elderly-hand-tremor-detection-analysis.

- Enables AI-powered detection and analysis of resting tremor in elderly hands using home camera video.
- Extracts tremor frequency (Hz) and amplitude (pixel displacement), and assesses risk level; triggers alerts when thresholds are exceeded.
- Strict open-id acquisition workflow ensures user data privacy and correct report retrieval.
- Supports scheduled or auto-triggered analysis, with results viewable as structured reports or in Markdown table format for history.
- Designed as an early screening aid for Parkinson’s and related neurological conditions in community and home care settings.
